blocks.text: Transition elements complex ions is liye banate hain ke in ke paas khaali (vacant) d orbitals hain jo energy ke lihaz se itne neeche (accessible) hain ke electron pairs le sakein. Central (darmiyani) transition metal ion, maslan Fe³⁺ ya Cu²⁺, ke (n-1)d orbitals adhoore bhare ya khaali hote hain.

blocks.alt: Cu2+(aq) + 4NH3(aq) se complex banta hai: beech mein Cu (charge 2+) aur square ke konon par chaar NH3, har aik N se Cu ki taraf teer ke saath, sab square brackets ke andar charge 2+ ke saath.
blocks.caption: [Cu(NH₃)₄]²⁺ complex ion ka banna (kitab ki be-number scheme ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har teer ek coordinate (dative) bond hai: NH₃ ka N apna lone pair Cu²⁺ ke khaali d orbital ko deta hai. Teer hamesha dene wale (ligand) se lene wale (metal) ki taraf hota hai. Chaar bond hain, is liye coordination number 4 hai.

In khaali d-orbitals ki energy itni kam hai ke yeh bond banane mein hissa le sakte hain. Metal ion ke khaali d-orbitals ligands ke diye hue lone pairs le lete hain aur coordinate covalent (dative) bonds bante hain. Electron pair dene wale molecules ya ions (H₂O, NH₃, Cl⁻) ko ligands kehte hain. Electron pairs ke dene aur lene se ek stable complex ion (coordination compound) banta hai.

Metal complex (coordination compound) woh molecule ya ion hai jo tab banta hai jab central metal atom ya ion ke gird kai electron dene wale molecules ya ions hon. Complex banne mein transition element Lewis acid (electron pair lene wala) ka kaam karta hai.

Ligand woh molecule ya ion hai (maslan H₂O, NH₃, Cl⁻) jis ke paas kam az kam ek lone pair ho aur jo central metal atom ya ion se coordinate (dative) bond banaye. Lafz "ligand" Latin ke “ligare” se nikla hai, jis ka matlab hai "baandhna". Ligand electron pair deta hai, is liye Lewis base hai.

Ligands ki kai types (qismein) hain. Negative (manfi) charge wale electron pair dene wale ions anionic ligands kehlate hain; yeh sab se zyada aam hain, maslan Cl⁻, CN⁻, OH⁻, C₂O₄²⁻. In ke naam aam tor par “-o” par khatam hote hain: chloride “chloro” aur cyanide “cyano” ban jata hai.

Neutral molecules jo electron pair de kar complex banate hain neutral ligands kehlate hain, maslan H₂O, NH₃, CO. In ke naam aam tor par wahi rehte hain, magar kuch ke khaas naam hain: H₂O (aqua), NH₃ (ammine) aur CO (carbonyl). Positive (musbat) charge wale electron pair dene wale ions cationic ligands hain; yeh kam milte hain aur in ke naam aksar “-ium” par khatam hote hain, maslan NO⁺ (nitrosonium), NH₂-NH₃⁺ (hydrazinium).

Monodentate ligand sirf ek electron pair deta hai, maslan H₂O, NH₃, CO, Cl⁻, OH⁻, CN⁻; har ek mein ligand ka sirf ek atom metal se dative bond banata hai. Bidentate ligand do electron pairs deta hai, maslan 1,2-diaminoethane (ethylenediamine) aur ethanedioate (oxalate) ion. 1,2-diaminoethane (H₂NCH₂CH₂NH₂, short form en) mein dono N atoms ek ek lone pair dete hain. Ethanedioate ion (C₂O₄²⁻) mein do O atoms, har carboxyl group se ek, electron pair dete hain.

Polydentate ligand woh hai jo ek hi metal atom/ion se do se zyada dative bonds banaye. Ethylenediaminetetraacetate ion (EDTA) aam misal hai; yeh hexadentate (chhe daant wala) ligand hai kyun ke chhe donor atoms (chaar oxygen aur do nitrogen) se metal ion ko pakarta hai.

blocks.alt: Teen ligands ke formulas: 1,2-diaminoethane (H2N-CH2-CH2-NH2), ethanedioate (do C atoms jure hue, har aik ke saath aik C=O aur aik O-) aur ethylenediaminetetraacetate, EDTA (do N atoms, har aik par lone pair, CH2-CH2 se jure, aur har N ke saath do CH2-COO- baazu).
blocks.caption: 1,2-diaminoethane, ethanedioate aur EDTA ka structure (kitab ke be-number structure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: 1,2-diaminoethane (en) ke do N atoms ek ek lone pair dete hain, is liye yeh bidentate hai. Ethanedioate mein do O⁻ atoms (har carboxyl group se ek) pairs dete hain; yeh bhi bidentate hai. EDTA ke do N aur chaar O⁻ mil kar chhe pairs dete hain, is liye yeh hexadentate (polydentate) hai.

Coordination number ligands aur central metal atom ya ion ke darmiyan dative bonds ka total number hai. Maslan complex ion [Fe(CN)₆]⁴⁻ mein central Fe²⁺ chhe CN⁻ ligands se juda hai, is liye coordination number 6 hai (Figure 18.2). Coordination number complex ka poora structure (banawat) tay karta hai.

Coordination sphere central metal atom ya ion aur us se seedhe jure ligands ka group (majmooa) hai. Yeh qareeb ka chemical environment (mahaul) batata hai aur aam tor par square brackets [Complex] mein likha jata hai.
Coordination sphere ka charge metal atom ya ion aur ligands ke charges ka sum (jama) hai. Metal ka charge = sphere ka charge − ligands ka total charge.

blocks.alt: [Fe(CN)6]4-: beech mein Fe (charge 2+) aur chhe CN ligands, har aik se Fe ki taraf teer, square brackets ke andar charge 4- ke saath. 'In this complex' ki list: central metal ion = Fe2+; ligand = CN-; coordination number = 6; ligands ka total charge = -6; metal par charge = +2; coordination sphere par charge = -4.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.2: Hexacyanoferrate (II) complex aur us ke hisse (kitab ki Figure 18.2 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 18.2 mein ‘Total Charge of ligands = 6’ chhapa hai; chhe CN⁻ ligands ka total charge 6 × (−1) = −6 hai, is liye drawing mein −6 likha hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Hisaab: sphere ka charge = metal + ligands = +2 + (−6) = −4. Har CN ligand C atom se judta hai aur sirf ek pair deta hai (monodentate), is liye chhe CN⁻ se coordination number 6 hai.

blocks.prompt: [Fe(CN)₆]⁴⁻ mein ligand, coordination number aur iron ka charge kya hain?
blocks.explanation: Ligand CN⁻ (cyano); coordination number 6; iron +2 hai, kyun ke −4 − 6 × (−1) = +2.

items: Complex is liye bante hain ke khaali d orbitals ligands ke lone pairs lete hain (coordinate bonds).
Ligands: anionic, neutral ya cationic; mono-, bi- ya polydentate (EDTA hexadentate).
Coordination number = dative bonds ka number; sphere ka charge = metal + ligands ke charges.
